## Become a Hunter

Gaimon spent twenty years stuck in a treasure chest guarding the Island of Rare Animals. He would want you to be gentle.

Choose Hunter as one of your professions.

**Tasks**

- Choose Hunter

**Rewards**

- Doriki +60, Belly +2,000, Hunter XP +300

## Journeyman Hunter

Little Garden is still in the age of the dinosaurs. Catch a Hercules beetle and a Rock Lizard on its rock.

Reach Hunter level 25, Catch a Hercules beetle, Catch a basking Rock Lizard and land on a wild island in Paradise.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Apprentice Hunter](hunter.md#q-667627ec92c7830a)

**Tasks**

- Reach Hunter level 25
- Catch a Hercules beetle
- Catch a basking Rock Lizard
- Land on a wild island in Paradise

**Rewards**

- Doriki +240, Belly +25,000, Hunter XP +3,000

<a id="q-79ef96adc59a90da"></a>

## Expert Hunter

Catch every creature of the islands, and the Golden Hercules besides.

Reach Hunter level 50 and complete the tasks below.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Journeyman Hunter](hunter.md#q-2cc579442baba32c)

**Tasks**

- Reach Hunter level 50
- Catch every creature of the islands
- Catch the Golden Hercules

**Rewards**

- Doriki +480, Belly +70,000, Hunter XP +7,000, New World Crate

<a id="q-37ebcc46dca5c843"></a>

## Master Hunter

The king of the beasts carries the hunter's title.

Reach Hunter level 100 and earn the title.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Expert Hunter](hunter.md#q-79ef96adc59a90da)

**Tasks**

- Reach Hunter level 100

**Rewards**

- Doriki +900, Belly +250,000, Legendary Crate
